app.title: Fretbook
app.tagline: Self-hosted tabs, chord sheets, and sheet music for bass and guitar.
app.notFound: That page is not in the book.

admin.heading: Users
admin.hint: People sign in through your identity provider. Members of the users group get their own library; members of the admins group also see this page. Roles are read at each sign-in.
admin.name: Name

adoptHint.one: {count} song was added before sign-in was turned on. Nobody can see it until an admin moves it into a library.
adoptHint.other: {count} songs were added before sign-in was turned on. Nobody can see them until an admin moves them into a library.

settings.defaultInstrumentHint: Used for new tabs and added tracks, and to pick the part when importing from Songsterr, Guitar Pro, or MusicXML.
settings.heading: Settings

ytdlp.label: Audio downloader (yt-dlp)
ytdlp.hint: Fretbook uses yt-dlp to download the audio of a synced video. YouTube changes often, so an old version stops working.
ytdlp.unknown: The version could not be read.

stale.one: This yt-dlp is {count} day old. Audio downloads may fail. Update it, or set FRETBOOK_YTDLP_AUTO_UPDATE=true, or upload audio instead.
stale.other: This yt-dlp is {count} days old. Audio downloads may fail. Update it, or set FRETBOOK_YTDLP_AUTO_UPDATE=true, or upload audio instead.

ytdlp.autoUpdateOn: Updates itself at start and once a day.

library.heading: Library
library.empty: No songs yet. Import a Songsterr link or a file, start a blank tab, or paste a chord sheet.
library.title: Title
library.pickTracksHint: {title} has more than one fretted track. Pick the ones to import.
library.file: MusicXML, Guitar Pro, ChordPro, text, or Fretbook JSON

chords.pasteHint: Paste a chord sheet. Chord lines above lyric lines are converted to ChordPro.
chords.editHint: ChordPro: chords in brackets before the syllable, like [G]Hello. {title: …}, {comment: …}, and {start_of_chorus} / {end_of_chorus} are understood. Chords over lyrics are converted on save.

player.usingPublished: Playback is using the published sync points. If the audio drifts, tap the bar where it goes wrong: later bars move with it.
player.needAudio: Sync points are saved, but there is no audio file yet. Upload an mp3 or wav.
player.synth: No audio file, so playback uses the built-in synth.
player.keys: Space plays. Arrows move a bar. T taps the next mark.

editor.heading: Edit
editor.conflict: This song was changed somewhere else after you opened it.
editor.barsAreShared: Bars are shared by every track: time, tempo, and sections apply to all of them, and inserting or deleting a bar does too. Sync marks move with their bars.
editor.barShort: Bar is short; the rest is filled with rests
editor.fretHint: Empty means no note. 0 is the open string.

import.youtubeUnavailable: YouTube import is not available yet
import.noFrettedTracks: This file has no fretted tracks.

auth.required: Your session has ended. Sign in again.

request.crossOrigin: Requests from other sites are not allowed.

song.notFound: That song is not in your library.
song.conflict: This song was changed somewhere else after you opened it.
song.badSignature: That time signature is not valid.
song.needsDocument: A tab needs its score to be saved.
song.needsChordPro: A chord sheet needs its text to be saved.

sync.badAnchor: Sync marks must belong to bars of this song.

upload.notAudio: Upload an mp3, wav, ogg, m4a, flac, or webm file.

audio.failed: Audio download failed. The tab was saved; you can upload an mp3.
audio.timeout: The audio download took longer than {seconds} seconds. The tab was saved; you can upload an mp3.
audio.badVideo: That is not a YouTube video id.
audio.signIn: YouTube asked for a sign-in or a bot check, so the audio could not be downloaded. The tab was saved; upload an mp3 instead.
audio.unavailable: That video is unavailable, private, or removed, so its audio could not be downloaded. The tab was saved; upload an mp3 instead.
audio.geoBlocked: That video is blocked in this server's country, so its audio could not be downloaded. The tab was saved; upload an mp3 instead.
audio.outdated: yt-dlp could not read YouTube's page, which usually means yt-dlp is out of date. The tab was saved; update yt-dlp or upload an mp3 instead.

export.notChords: Only chord sheets export as ChordPro.

job.interrupted: The server restarted during this import. Start it again.
job.noHandler: This kind of import is not available.
job.timeout: The import is taking too long.

import.notImplemented: This importer is not available yet.
import.noUrlImporter: No importer matches this link. Songsterr links work today; YouTube frame import is not available yet.
import.noFileImporter: No importer matches this file. Try MusicXML, Guitar Pro, ChordPro, or a Fretbook JSON export.
import.noPreview: This link has no track list to choose from.
import.guitarProInBrowser: Guitar Pro files are read in the browser. Use the import button in Fretbook.
import.syncCountMismatch: The source has {points} sync points for {bars} bars, so playback may drift.
import.noSyncPoints: No sync points are published for this song.
import.keptEditedCopy: "{title}" was edited since it was imported, so this import was saved as a separate song.
import.anchorsDropped: The new import has fewer bars, so some sync marks were dropped.

songsterr.noState: Songsterr's page could not be read. The site may have changed.
songsterr.idMismatch: The Songsterr page does not match the link.
songsterr.noSuchPart: None of the requested Songsterr parts are fretted tracks.
songsterr.noFrettedTrack: This song has no fretted track ({names}).
songsterr.badVideo: Songsterr named an unexpected video id.

musicxml.parse: The MusicXML file could not be read.
musicxml.timewise: Timewise MusicXML is not supported. Save it as partwise.
musicxml.notMusicXml: This is not a MusicXML score.
musicxml.noTab: This MusicXML file has no tablature (string and fret) data.

json.parse: The JSON file could not be read.
json.notFretbook: This JSON file is not a Fretbook export.

chords.notText: The chord sheet is not UTF-8 text.
chords.tooLong: The chord sheet is longer than {limit} characters.
